judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: This is a non-linked stock photo on a navigation card (a library with people pulling books off the shelves), and the card's h3 is also "Research and teaching". The alt names the topic the photo illustrates. It is not false about the image, since a library scene does depict research, and it is not a filename-style non-alternative. WCAG does not require a literal description of an illustrative card photo. At most, alt="" would avoid repeating the heading, which is redundancy and not the mismatch the finding claims. The model passed the same pattern on the Visit, About us and Open Days cards.
